points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克出生于伦敦莱顿斯顿的一个中产阶级天主教家庭。他的父亲威廉·希区柯克是一位水果商和家禽批发商，母亲艾玛·简·威尔逊是一位家庭主妇。希区柯克童年体弱多病，被送入圣伊格内修斯学院接受教育。这段经历对他后来的创作产生了深远影响，尤其是对权威、惩罚和内疚等主题的探索。他在学校表现优异，但体重超重，性格内向，这些特质也反映在他后来的作品中。
points.descriptionEn: Alfred Hitchcock was born in Leytonstone, London, to a middle-class Catholic family. His father William Hitchcock was a greengrocer and poultry dealer, while his mother Emma Jane Wilson was a housewife. As a child, Hitchcock was often ill and was sent to St. Ignatius' College for education. This experience profoundly influenced his later work, particularly his exploration of themes like authority, punishment, and guilt. He excelled in school but was overweight and introverted, traits that would later reflect in his films.

points.title: 英国电影生涯
points.description: 希区柯克的电影生涯始于1920年，当时他以字幕设计师和艺术指导的身份加入伦敦的拉斯莫尔制片公司。他迅速晋升为导演，1925年执导了首部重要作品《山鹰》。1926年的《房客》确立了其独特的视觉风格和心理惊悚元素。1929年，他拍摄了英国第一部有声电影《讹诈》。1930年代，希区柯克创作了一系列经典作品，包括《三十九级台阶》(1935)、《贵妇失踪案》(1938)和《牙买加旅馆》(1939)，这些作品为他赢得了国际声誉，奠定了'悬疑大师'的地位。
points.descriptionEn: Hitchcock's film career began in 1920 when he joined the Islington Studios of London as a title designer and art director. He quickly rose to become a director, making his first significant film 'The Mountain Eagle' in 1925. 'The Lodger' (1926) established his distinctive visual style and psychological thriller elements. In 1929, he directed 'Blackmail', Britain's first sound film. During the 1930s, Hitchcock created a series of classics including 'The 39 Steps' (1935), 'The Lady Vanishes' (1938), and 'Jamaica Inn' (1939), which earned him international acclaim and established him as the 'Master of Suspense'.

points.title: 好莱坞过渡期
points.description: 1939年，希区柯克接受大卫·O·塞尔兹尼克的邀请，前往好莱坞发展。他在纽约短暂停留后，于1940年拍摄了美国首部作品《蝴蝶梦》，该片获得奥斯卡最佳影片奖，这是希区柯克唯一一次获得该奖项。这部作品标志着希区柯克从英国导演到国际电影大师的转变，同时也展现了他对好莱坞制片体系的适应能力。尽管获得了商业成功，希区柯克仍保持了对创作控制的坚持，这成为他日后与制片厂关系的特点。
points.descriptionEn: In 1939, Hitchcock accepted an invitation from David O. Selznick to move to Hollywood. After a brief stay in New York, he made his American debut with 'Rebecca' in 1940, which won the Academy Award for Best Picture—the only time Hitchcock would receive this honor. This film marked Hitchcock's transition from British director to international film maestro while showcasing his adaptation to the Hollywood studio system. Despite commercial success, Hitchcock maintained his insistence on creative control, a characteristic that would define his relationship with studios throughout his career.

points.title: 黄金创作期
points.description: 在洛杉矶的这段时期，希区柯克创作了一系列最具影响力的作品，包括《深闺疑云》(1941)、《辣手摧花》(1943)、《美人计》(1946)、《绳索》(1948)、《后窗》(1954)和《捉贼记》(1955)。这些作品展现了他对电影技巧的精湛掌握，尤其是对悬念、视觉叙事和观众心理的操控。希区柯克在这一时期发展了自己独特的电影语言，将心理分析元素引入商业电影，同时探索了道德模糊性和人性阴暗面。他与编剧的合作也达到了新的高度，特别是与约翰·迈克尔·海斯和雷蒙德·钱德勒的合作。
points.descriptionEn: During his time in Los Angeles, Hitchcock created some of his most influential works, including 'Suspicion' (1941), 'Shadow of a Doubt' (1943), 'Notorious' (1946), 'Rope' (1948), 'Rear Window' (1954), and 'To Catch a Thief' (1955). These films showcased his mastery of cinematic techniques, particularly his manipulation of suspense, visual storytelling, and audience psychology. During this period, Hitchcock developed his distinctive cinematic language, introducing psychological elements into commercial cinema while exploring moral ambiguity and human darkness. His collaborations with writers also reached new heights, especially with John Michael Hayes and Raymond Chandler.

points.title: 巅峰与转型
points.description: 这一时期是希区柯克职业生涯的巅峰，他创作了《迷魂记》(1958)、《西北偏北》(1959)、《惊魂记》(1960)和《鸟》(1963)等经典作品。《惊魂记》的上映标志着希区柯克对恐怖片类型的革新，其叙事技巧和视觉效果影响了后世无数导演。希区柯克在这一时期开始更多地关注个人主题，如性心理、身份认同和暴力冲动。同时，他开始尝试电视制作，1955-1965年间执导了《希区柯克剧场》系列，这使他接触到更广泛的观众群体，并进一步发展了他对观众心理的把握。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the peak of Hitchcock's career, during which he created classics like 'Vertigo' (1958), 'North by Northwest' (1959), 'Psycho' (1960), and 'The Birds' (1964). The release of 'Psycho' revolutionized the horror genre, with its narrative techniques and visual influences affecting countless directors. During this time, Hitchcock began to focus more on personal themes such as sexual psychology, identity, and violent impulses. Simultaneously, he ventured into television production, directing the 'Alfred Hitchcock Presents' series from 1955-1965, which exposed him to a broader audience and further developed his understanding of audience psychology.

points.title: 晚年与遗产
points.description: 希区柯克晚年的作品包括《艳贼》(1964)、《狂凶记》(1972)和家庭惊悚片《家庭阴谋》(1976)。尽管这些作品不如他早期的杰作受到广泛赞誉，但它们仍展现了他对电影语言的持续探索。1979年，希区柯克获得美国电影学会终身成就奖。1980年4月29日，他在洛杉矶逝世，享年80岁。希区柯克去世后，他的作品和影响力持续增长，被公认为电影史上最重要的导演之一。他的电影技巧、叙事方法和主题探索影响了从布莱恩·德·帕尔玛到昆汀·塔伦蒂诺等众多后世导演，他的名字也成为悬疑和惊悚类型的代名词。
points.descriptionEn: Hitchcock's later works included 'Marnie' (1964), 'Frenzy' (1972), and the family thriller 'Family Plot' (1976). Although these works didn't receive the same acclaim as his earlier masterpieces, they still demonstrated his continued exploration of cinematic language. In 1979, Hitchcock received the AFI Life Achievement Award. He died in Los Angeles on April 29, 1980, at the age of 80. After his death, his work and influence continued to grow, establishing him as one of the most important directors in film history. His cinematic techniques, narrative methods, and thematic explorations influenced countless later directors, from Brian De Palma to Quentin Tarantino, and his name became synonymous with suspense and thriller genres.

supporter.zh: 希区柯克被誉为'悬疑大师'，他对电影艺术的贡献无可估量。他革新了悬疑片的叙事方式，将心理深度引入商业电影，创造了独特的视觉语言。希区柯克对观众心理的精准把握使他能够创造出令人难忘的悬念时刻，如《惊魂记》中的淋浴场景。他的作品超越了单纯的娱乐，成为探索人性阴暗面、社会规范和道德模糊性的艺术表达。希区柯克的影响不仅限于电影领域，还延伸至文学、艺术和流行文化，使他成为20世纪最具标志性的文化人物之一。
supporter.en: Hitchcock is hailed as the 'Master of Suspense,' and his contributions to the art of cinema are immeasurable. He revolutionized the thriller genre by introducing psychological depth into commercial films and creating a distinctive visual language. Hitchcock's precise understanding of audience psychology enabled him to create unforgettable suspense moments, such as the shower scene in 'Psycho.' His works transcended mere entertainment to become artistic expressions exploring human darkness, social norms, and moral ambiguity. Hitchcock's influence extends beyond cinema into literature, art, and popular culture, making him one of the most iconic cultural figures of the 20th century.

critic.zh: 批评者指出希区柯克作品中的性别问题，尤其是对女性角色的刻板描绘，常常将女性描绘为受害者或诱惑者。他的电影中反复出现的'金发女郎'原型被批评为物化女性。此外，希区柯克对暴力的处理方式也受到质疑，有时被指责为美化暴力或利用暴力作为噱头。他的个人生活也受到审视，有评论认为他的作品反映了控制欲和潜在的性别歧视。尽管希区柯克声称自己的电影只是'娱乐'，但批评者认为他的作品中的性别政治和暴力美学需要更深入的批判性分析。
critic.en: Critics point out gender issues in Hitchcock's work, particularly his stereotypical portrayals of women, often depicting them as victims or temptresses. The recurring 'blonde' archetype in his films has been criticized for objectifying women. Additionally, Hitchcock's treatment of violence has been questioned, sometimes accused of glorifying violence or using it as a gimmick. His personal life has also come under scrutiny, with some suggesting his work reflects controlling tendencies and potential sexism. Despite Hitchcock's claims that his films were merely 'entertainment,' critics argue that the gender politics and aesthetics of violence in his work require more critical analysis.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，希区柯克已成为电影史上最重要的导演之一，他的名字几乎成为悬疑和惊悚类型的代名词。希区柯克不仅是一位技艺精湛的电影制作者，更是一位具有独特视觉风格和叙事方法的艺术家。他的作品超越了时代限制，持续影响着后世电影人。在流行文化中，希区柯克的形象被不断重塑，从严肃艺术家到文化偶像，他的名字和形象已成为全球文化符号。电影学者对他的作品进行了多角度解读，从弗洛伊德心理分析到后现代主义视角，使他的作品成为电影理论研究的丰富资源。
objective.en: From a historical and popular culture perspective, Hitchcock has become one of the most important directors in film history, his name almost synonymous with the suspense and thriller genres. Hitchcock was not only a masterful filmmaker but also an artist with a distinctive visual style and narrative approach. His works have transcended time, continuing to influence later generations of filmmakers. In popular culture, Hitchcock's image has been constantly reinvented, from serious artist to cultural icon, making his name and image a global cultural symbol. Film scholars have interpreted his work from multiple angles, from Freudian psychoanalysis to postmodern perspectives, making his films a rich resource for film theory studies.

self.zh: 电影是一种比现实更真实的幻象。
self.en: Cinema is a form of writing that is more real than reality.

others.zh: 希区柯克是电影界的莎士比亚，他创造了我们这个时代最持久的神话。
others.en: Hitchcock is the Shakespeare of the cinema, he has created the most enduring myths of our time.
